DGCA restricts power bank carriage on flights after Indigo incident

The Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) has prohibited the carriage of power banks on flights, following an incident involving an IndiGo aircraft. The decision aims to prevent potential dangers associated with power banks on airplanes. Passengers are advised to check their power banks before heading to the airport, with specific attention drawn to a particular model that has been restricted.
